label: Mom + Pop Records
release_notes: First album for Mom + Pop after leaving Mendel Records. Follows 2025's is a Folk Artist.
Freeman calls it a post-apocalyptic road trip album in the vein of Illinois, Nebraska and Ghosts of the Great Highway (JamBase).
Press cites Sufjan Stevens, Andy Shauf and Wednesday as inspirations. 11 songs.
Record release show at Bowery Ballroom, Nov. 6. Out Nov. 6, so not final until release.
Runtimes unavailable until the album posts.
draft_comment: Lo-fi singer-songwriter goes full band on a post-apocalyptic road trip record. Nebraska by way of Wednesday, if the pitch holds.
